title: Ironkeeper configuration
description: Strict, versioned configuration document for the Ironkeeper daemon. Every object boundary rejects unknown properties. The safety block is deliberately minimal and its mandatory values are enforced semantically, not only structurally.

schema_version.description: Version of this configuration contract. Only version 1 is implemented.

daemon.description: Runtime locations used by the daemon.

state_directory.description: Absolute path of the directory holding durable state and evidence.

socket_path.description: Absolute path of the AF_UNIX control socket.

safety.description: Safety policy. The values in this block are mandatory and are not configurable away in milestone M0: allow_destructive_operations must be false, require_explicit_enrollment must be true, and allow_tests_on_in_use_devices must be false.

require_explicit_enrollment.description: Devices must be explicitly enrolled before any assessment. Must be true.

allow_destructive_operations.description: Whether destructive operations are permitted. Must be false in milestone M0; the schema accepts only false so that the value cannot be configured away.

allow_tests_on_in_use_devices.description: Whether self-tests may be started on devices that are in use. Must be false in milestone M0.
